verdict.rationale: Shopify has AI features, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client that consumes external tools; the axis applies. The pack shows only the opposite role: Shopify publishes MCP servers (Storefront, Cart, Checkout, Order) and an AI Toolkit that lets outside AI agents and coding tools connect to Shopify. Neither counts as Shopify plugging in external MCP servers, and nothing in the pack shows that it does.
